task.name: Strike_communal_kitchen
task.when: During Strike after the Food Lead closes the kitchen

resources.resource: Food Lead, Water Lead, Propane Lead, and Build Lead

step.action: Have the Food Lead remove or discard all remaining food according to the food plan.
Have the Propane Lead disconnect and remove 🔥 Kitchen_Propane_Supply.
Have the Water Lead disconnect 🔧 Camp_Sink and move all contained water to its approved destination.
Pack fully dry kitchenware in its assigned transport containers.
Have the Water Lead empty and dry 🍳 Drinking_Water_Dispensers without releasing water onto the playa.
Fold and pack the kitchen tables in the order shown in 📦 Build_Book.
Dismantle the kitchen carport in the printed strike sequence.
Put every kitchen fastener and anchor in its assigned hardware bin.
Clean, dry, fold, and pack the kitchen ground covering.

passWhen.criterion: No food, propane, fresh water, or gray water remains in the dismantled kitchen.
Every kitchen component, table, utensil, fastener, and anchor is clean, dry, accounted for, and packed.
The former kitchen footprint is clear and MOOP-free.
